bin/vlab.js.responsibility: Minimal executable entry point and error/exit boundary

src/cli.js.responsibility: Argument parsing, command dispatch, human and JSON presentation, benchmarks

src/errors.js.responsibility: Expected CLI error type carrying a classification code from the closed `ERROR_CODES` vocabulary of the `vcs-lab.error/v1` failure envelope (ADR-0021)

src/ids.js.responsibility: Unique protocol IDs, SHA-256, Git blob hashing, slugs

src/canonical-json.js.responsibility: The frozen `vcs-lab.canonical-json/v1` profile: RFC 8785 restricted to UTF-16-code-unit-sorted members and safe integers, refusing what it cannot serialize byte-identically

src/engine.js.responsibility: The read-side engine seam: the catalog of 44 read operations, the read-engine selector, per-operation native execution and fallback, composites, and the differential comparison

src/native-engine.js.responsibility: Optional in-process Node-API binding loader and conversion for the five bounded resolution-catalog read operations
src/native-engine.js.dependencies: Optional `native/prebuilds` binding, Node module and path utilities

src/git.js.responsibility: The Git engine: safe synchronous Git adapter, the Git implementation of every read operation, repository context, object and merge-tree sessions, engine selectors, the read-bypass rule, metrics

src/git-session-worker.js.responsibility: Owns asynchronous `git cat-file --batch-command` stream for a synchronous caller

src/merge-tree-session-worker.js.responsibility: Owns one asynchronous `git merge-tree --stdin` stream for the synchronous merge-tree forecast engine

src/store.js.responsibility: Common runtime directory and atomic JSON read/write

src/notes.js.responsibility: Append/list/read causal records in `refs/notes/vcs-lab`, including one batched read for many targets; every writer of the ref is serialized on the notes lock in the shared runtime directory

src/provenance.js.responsibility: Declared authorship provenance (`vcs-lab.provenance/v1`): the closed role vocabulary, `VLAB_AGENT`, declaration at commit time, and exact carry onto rewritten commits

src/schemas.js.responsibility: Supported schema registry, structural record validation, object-reference and resolution-signature rules

src/metadata.js.responsibility: Deterministic inventory, scope classification, integrity diagnostics, lineage, and accepted-record filtering

src/identity-audit.js.responsibility: Repository-wide logical identity audit (`vcs-lab.identity-audit/v1`): union-find over identity-preserving application edges, multi-trailer, multi-origin, and invariant findings, plus the near-duplicate provenance actor warning

src/metadata-envelope.js.responsibility: Canonical envelope manifest, integrity hash, payload bounds, and parser

src/metadata-transfer.js.responsibility: Sanitized bundle export, dry-run inspection, conflict planning, staging, and atomic ref import

src/proof-binding.js.responsibility: The Git bindings a proof bundle carries so a verifier without the repository can check it: the bound source inventory, reachability paths, receipt inclusion proofs, and the object-id recomputation that makes them proofs (ADR-0031)

src/target-overlay.js.responsibility: Target overlays: resolving the checkpoint a `--target-checkpoint` forecast is about, predicting the tree the worktree holds after one is put back, and reducing, re-materializing, and restoring it without ever committing it (ADR-0028)

src/capabilities.js.responsibility: The `vcs-lab.capabilities/v1` document projected from the runtime registries, and negotiation as a pure function of two such documents (ADR-0033)

src/quarantine.js.responsibility: The conflict policy's two local stores: parked conflicting records as one blob-bearing ref each under `refs/vcs-lab/quarantine/<lineage>/<record id>`, and the shared-local disposition registry (ADR-0030)

src/dispositions.js.responsibility: Resolving one parked conflict: keep-local or replace-local, the note rewrite it implies, and the recorded decision that stops the same disagreement being reported twice (ADR-0030)

src/git-carriers.js.responsibility: Copy-on-write notes trees, typed dependency closure, bounded carrier parents, and checked ref commands

src/retention.js.responsibility: Read-only retention preview and checked, idempotent historical backfill

src/scale-benchmark.js.responsibility: Bounded synthetic repository fixture, scan measurements, raw-Git floors for the phases with a plain-Git equivalent, semantic equality checks, and evidence-based optimization recommendations

src/landings.js.responsibility: Compact and hard-squash landing mechanics and receipts

src/merge-plan.js.responsibility: Coverage proof lattice, effective base, patch candidates, plan formatting

src/proof-bundle.js.responsibility: Portable coverage proof bundles and their independent verifier, which applies its own copy of the lattice (`PROOF_RULES`) and compares the evidence with the repository
src/proof-bundle.js.dependencies: Merge plan, canonical JSON, metadata, engine

src/rebase-plan.js.responsibility: Read-only rebase selection, actions, preserved merge topology, shape constraints, and deterministic fingerprint
src/rebase-plan.js.dependencies: Merge plan, rebase topology, Git adapter, IDs

src/rebase-forecast.js.responsibility: Rebase simulation orchestration, caller invariants, candidate pinning, the carried caller overlay and its second predicted tree, and private forecast presentation
src/rebase-forecast.js.dependencies: Rebase plan, forecast simulator, target overlays, semantic version guards, Git adapter

src/rebase-operations.js.responsibility: Current-branch rebase replay, forecast enforcement, overlay reduction and re-materialization, conflict recovery, identity, and final receipts
src/rebase-operations.js.dependencies: Rebase plan/forecast, target overlays, Git, notes, specs, resolutions

src/rebase-state.js.responsibility: Worktree-private rebase journal path and atomic persistence

src/rebase-topology.js.responsibility: Range topology analysis, ADR-0034 merge shape scope, the rewrite program and its parent mapping, and the recreated-merge identity contract

src/pending-operation.js.responsibility: Safe reconciliation/rebase journal routing for shared conflict tools

src/faults.js.responsibility: Test-only deterministic fault injection: `VLAB_TEST_FAULT` turns one named point on a mutating path into a hard `process.exit`; `VLAB_TEST_GATE` holds a process at a named point until a test releases it

src/forecasts.js.responsibility: Plan fingerprint, merge-tree and temporary-worktree simulation engines with recorded fallback, decision pinning, saved forecasts
src/forecasts.js.dependencies: Plan, operations helpers, specs, resolutions, Git

src/reconcile-state.js.responsibility: Worktree-private reconciliation journal and Git in-progress state probes

src/resolutions.js.responsibility: Exact three-way conflict signatures, candidate selection, result retention, outcome audit

src/workspaces.js.responsibility: Workspace registry/lifecycle, linked-worktree materialization, temporary-index checkpoints/history

src/workspace-lock.js.responsibility: Exclusive shared-local registry transaction lock, bounded refusal, and ownership-checked release

src/specs.js.responsibility: Markdown parsing, sparse manifest migration/indexing, deterministic merge, semantic resolution, benchmark
